messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to flip the new autoscale policy for the dedicated-gpu pool tonight at 21:00 PT. Need a quick sync: who is doing the deploy, what are the smoke checks, and rollback readiness? Plan is canary ~10% for 15m then ramp.

sam: I can run the deploy. Target 21:00 PT (04:00 UTC). I'll use infra-deploy pipeline (job: infra/deploy/autoscale). Canary = 1 slice (~10%). Monitor 15m, then 50% for 30m, then 100% if healthy.

alex: What metrics should we watch? I’ll be monitoring dashboards but call out the critical ones.

sam: Critical: GPU utilization, pod eviction rate, request p95/p99, token throughput, and node CPU/IO. Also watch cost-rate (tokens/sec * $/token). Link to dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/dedicated/gpu-pool-overview

alex: Good. Also watch KV cache hitrate and model tail-latency (p99 gen). If we see evictions or sudden p99 spikes > +50% from baseline, rollback.

nina: Rollback plan? How do we revert policy quickly if something goes wrong?

sam: Rollback steps: 1) Pause rollout via infra UI or cancel pipeline. 2) Re-apply previous autoscale policy: `terraform apply -target=module.autoscaler -var='policy=stable_v2025'` 3) Manually scale down new slices: `kubectl scale sts/gpu-slice-<name> --replicas=0 -n dedicated` 4) Trigger emergency capacity fallback: `infra ops fallback reserved` (runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/company/runbooks/autoscale-rollback).

ryan: I'll notify eng-oncall and set temporary alert thresholds to P1 for p99 and eviction spikes during the window.

devops-bot: Deployment scheduled by sam for 1977777777 at 21:00 PT. Pipeline: infra/deploy/autoscale. Canary target: 1 slice.

maya: Smoke-check script? Can someone paste the exact command I'll run after canary goes live?

sam: Use this quick smoke script, 60s run at low qps:
```bash
python ./scripts/smoke_check.py --env=dedicated --qps=1 --duration=60 --model=redwood-1
```
It posts results to #eng-releases by default. Check for "no evictions" and p99 < 1s.

alex: I'll tail logs and run a local curl to the router as well: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}'`

nina: Also note maintenance window – no non-critical deploys in the platform team during this time.

sam: Canary started at 21:01 PT. Running smoke now.

sam: Smoke results: no pod evictions, GPU util ~72%, p95 160ms, p99 235ms (+18ms over baseline). KV hit ~88%. No errors in logs. :thumbsup:

maya: Looks good to me. Proceed to 50% ramp at 21:20 PT.

sam: Ramp to 50% initiated. Watching rollouts.

alex: Seeing a small tail-latency blip on one slice — investigating.

alex: False alarm, restarted one proxy, p99 back to baseline.

sam: 50% held for 30m, metrics stable. Proceeding to 100% now.

devops-bot: Autoscale policy rollout reached 100% for dedicated-gpu pool at 22:15 PT (1977779888).

sam: Completed 100% at 22:15 PT. Post-rollout checks: no evictions, overall p99 +10ms, cost delta +1.8%. Will follow up with perf report.

maya: Great job — thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes and mark as completed. :tada:
